sections.voiceover: Before 2010, satellite data recorded shrinking mangrove forests worldwide. Researchers Zhen Zhang and Nicholas J. Why did mangroves in Palaw Township spread into old rice fields?

sections.voiceover: But around 2010, NASA Earth Observatory recorded mangrove forests shifting to net expansion across Asia.
